<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>SetNet.GameData</id>
    <version>1.2.0</version>
    <authors>Artem Lemeshev</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <icon>icon.png</icon>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/Povstalez/SetNet</projectUrl>
    <description>Static game-data tables for SetNet: load item/skill/npc/spawn definitions from JSON into fast id-keyed DataTable<TId,TRow> lookups, hot-reloadable at runtime. Rows are your own POCOs, so every table can carry any custom columns. No wire protocol; usable server- and client-side. Depends only on System.Text.Json.</description>
    <tags>gamedata tables config mmo setnet</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/Povstalez/SetNet.git" commit="7cd4d30fc745de4f7cda37604c2328c84a5c7fbc" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework=".NETStandard2.1">
        <dependency id="System.Text.Json" version="8.0.5" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
